data.title: 空门苍 · 粗点心店缘侧的波子汽水微醺梦
data.description: 阳光温暖的粗点心店木质缘侧上，苍系着兼职小围裙，抱着抱枕趴在木桌上打着哈欠昏昏欲睡，桌上倒映着喝了一半的波子汽水和风铃微光。
data.location: sun-drenched rustic sweet shop wooden veranda porch overlooking green island garden
data.action: slumped lazily over low wooden table hugging a round cushion, yawning adorably with drooped half-lidded eyes, half-empty ramune bottle beside
data.lighting: 庭院筛落的明媚午后树影金光
data.promptProse: Ao lounges lazily across a sunlit candy store porch hugging a cushion beside a glass ramune bottle, yawning with sleepy amber eyes.
data.animaCaption: Dappled garden sunlight warms the wooden porch as she yawns peacefully over her cushion.
